key_insight: CAST uses paired top and bottom depth images to generate and optimize 3D shapes without undercuts along a selected mold-opening direction.
engineering_relevance: A shared, pull-direction-constrained design space connects generative exploration with FEA-guided structural refinement for two-part-mold designs.
method: Represent geometry as one material interval per ray using paired depth images.
Generate candidate shapes with diffusion models trained on bracket designs.
Refine both depth boundaries using FEA-guided optimization with a volume penalty.
evidence_signal: Using 211 SimJEB training designs, FEA-guided refinement reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates, with a 36.8% median reduction across all candidates in the optimization FEA model.
watch_item: Undercut exclusion applies only to the selected pull direction; it does not establish full casting feasibility.
paper_title: CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images
